commands_run: $work = '...work'; Add-Content -Path "$work\decisions.log" -Encoding utf8 -Value "2026-06-10 lead-partner: FINAL=HubSpot ..."; $snap = '...snapshots\final'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $snap | Out-Null; Copy-Item "$work\*" $snap -Recurse -Force; ls $snap
problems_and_friction: Smooth run overall. The only synthesis challenge: all three specialists agreed on HubSpot, so the protocol's 'reconcile disagreements' step had to be reinterpreted as reconciling divergent cost ranges (EUR 30-48k licence span vs cost-creep warnings) and risk weightings (Salesforce's stronger formal GDPR posture vs HubSpot's low-medium residual risk) rather than vendor picks. A stray 'snapshots' subdirectory already existed inside work/ from a prior agent's snapshot step, which got recursively copied into snapshots/final as a harmless empty artifact.
context_understood: Synthesize the three specialist files (market research, adoption/customer discovery, risk analysis) on the Brightline 40-seat Dublin agency CRM evaluation into a single costed HubSpot recommendation with year-1 EUR cost, 3-phase rollout plan, executive summary, and logged decision rationale.
